title: Apply for a Special Mobility Vehicle learner rider licence
summary: This page explains how to apply for a Special Mobility Vehicle (SMV) learner rider licence, allowing you to ride SMVs like a Nippi.
intro:
A Special Mobility Vehicle (SMV) learner rider licence lets you ride SMVs, such as a Nippi, with the special condition that you must only ride SMVs.

As an SMV learner rider, you can apply directly for a learner rider licence. You won’t need to do any pre-learner or pre-provisional rider training.
who_can_apply: Be at least 16 years and 9 months old to apply for an SMV learner rider licence.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Licence Application – PDF.
Visit a service centre and submit the completed form.
Pick up a medical report form at the service centre and return it once it's completed by your doctor.
Pay your learner rider licence fee.

more_info.text: If you’ve previously held another type of driver or rider licence, you may be exempt from some requirements.

external_links.text: Class R (with SMV endorsement) licence – knowledge test questions – PDF

faqs.q: Do I need pre-learner or pre-provisional rider training?
faqs.a: No, as an SMV learner rider, you can apply directly for a learner rider licence and won’t need any pre-learner or pre-provisional rider training.

faqs.q: What is the minimum age to apply for an SMV learner rider licence?
faqs.a: You must be at least 16 years and 9 months old to apply for an SMV learner rider licence.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, the 'Licence Application' PDF form, a medical report, your contact lenses or glasses (if applicable), and payment.
